summary: This bill amends the Surface Mining Control and Reclamation Act of 1977 to strengthen environmental protections by setting stricter deadlines for reclamation activities, increasing water monitoring requirements, and modifying conditions for permit revisions and bond releases for surface coal mining operations.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on strengthening environmental controls and reclamation requirements for surface coal mining operations. It mandates stricter timelines for reclamation, improved drainage control, and more rigorous monitoring of water quality and biological conditions of streams, all of which directly contribute to environmental protection.
